This lesson covers Area (Surface of Objects), part of Measurement 3.5 Money (Kenyan currency) - Ksh.1 coins (10 lessons) By the end of in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How many small similar objects can cover given surfaces?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
